'''Chin Akima''' was the owner of a circus.

==Activities==
Three days before [[Valan Luca]] arrives at [[Samara]], Chin Akima has his circus in place. His circus has a man who juggles knives and axes and nine acrobats. A few days later, he is beheaded by the [[Masema Dagar|Prophet]] when he does not move his circus fast enough.
